messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: algebraic number field construction optimizing 3x3 determinant spectra

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square is given by the set {(σ₁(aᵢ)/σ₁(α), σ₂(aᵢ)/σ₂(α), σ₃(aᵢ)/σ₃(α)) : i=1,...,13} where α is the fundamental unit of Q(ζ₁₃)⁺ and aᵢ are the 13 integer representatives of Z[ζ₁₃]⁺/αZ[ζ₁₃]⁺ with minimal trace norm, yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/168, which equals 1/(2·(13²-13-2)) and is optimal because the norm-form structure forces every 3×3 minor of the resulting Vandermonde-type matrix to be a nonzero algebraic integer whose absolute norm is bounded below by 1."}
